correctness.rationale: Every cyclic input is equivalent to a closed path in the four-vertex labeled de Bruijn graph, including n=1 and n=2. Boolean relation machines of at most 2^16 states recognize all cyclic one-step output words. Direct enumeration for all 256 rules through n=8 gives 100 signature classes; complete synchronized product BFS checks all 156 nonrepresentative pairs and proves within-group language identity for every length. Other groups differ by a word at length <=8. Rules 57/99 match through 7 but differ on 00010011 at 8, witnessed for Rule 57 by predecessor 11100101. Standalone verifier passed, including independent brute-force versus automata cross-check.
